title: Grokking as a Subspace Search: Computing the Destination Before Training
abstract: arXiv:2611.30116v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Grokking is the phenomenon in which a neural network generalizes long after it has memorized its training data. Many explanations have been proposed for the delay between memorization and generalization. However, none of them can say before training where the network is heading, so they cannot be tested against one another. We show that on group tasks this destination can be computed from the task itself before training begins. It is a low-dimensional subspace of the network's embeddings, which we call the right subspace, and we prove that it is essentially unique. Knowing the destination makes our hypothesis falsifiable: the delay is a search for the right subspace, and generalization begins when the network finds it. When we give the network the right subspace from the start, the delay disappears. translated_title: 作为子空间搜索的Grokking：在训练之前计算最终目的地
translated_abstract: Grokking是指神经网络在记住训练数据很久之后才泛化的现象。针对记忆与泛化之间的这一延迟，已有许多解释被提出。然而，这些解释都无法在训练之前预言网络将走向何方，因此无法对它们进行相互检验。我们证明，在群任务上，这一目的地可以在训练开始之前从任务本身计算出来：它是网络嵌入中的一个低维子空间，我们称之为“正确子空间”，并且我们证明它本质上是唯一的。知晓这一目的地使我们的假设变得可证伪：延迟就是对正确子空间的搜索，当网络找到它时，泛化便开始了。当我们从一开始就把正确子空间提供给网络时，延迟消失了；当我们移除正确子空间时，准确率会停在一个我们在训练之前就能计算出的上限上，而在乘法任务上，网络无法……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文证明在群任务上，Grokking的最终目标——网络嵌入中一个本质唯一的低维“正确子空间”——可以在训练开始之前直接从任务本身计算出来，从而将Grokking重新解释为对该子空间的搜索，并通过提供或移除该子空间的干预实验验证了这一可证伪假设。
en_tdlr: On group tasks, the grokking destination—a provably essentially unique low-dimensional "right subspace" of the network's embeddings—can be computed from the task itself before training begins, reframing grokking as a search for that subspace and yielding a falsifiable hypothesis validated by intervention experiments.
